title: The Serum BLACKPINK’s LISA Uses for Plump, Glowing Skin Is 30% Off for October Prime Day
summary: Usually $165, the Japanese beauty brand’s bestselling serum is down to $115 during Amazon’s two-day savings event.
contentText:

Amazon’s October Prime Day is officially underway, and among the thousands of markdowns competing for your cart is a luxury skin-care deal with LISA’s stamp of approval .

For Prime Big Deal Days, running Oct. 6 and 7, Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum is 30% off at Amazon, bringing the $165 serum down to $115. The beauty staple is one BLACKPINK fans may already recognize: LISA became a global brand ambassador for Shiseido in 2026 and uses Ultimune as part of her own skin-care routine.

GET AMAZON PRIME 30-DAY FREE TRIAL

The deal also arrives during a busy month for LISA. The singer is set to release her new EP, “ PRESS PLAY ,” on Oct. 23, following her 2025 solo debut album, “Alter Ego,” which reached No. 1 on Billboard ’s Top Album Sales chart . She previously kicked off her solo career with the 2021 single album LALISA , featuring “LALISA” and “MONEY,” and reunited with BLACKPINK for the group’s 2026 mini album, DEADLINE , and accompanying DEADLINE world tour.

When she isn’t onstage, LISA also has plenty of red carpets to get ready for. According to Shiseido, the singer and actress reaches for Ultimune to prep her skin ahead of major appearances and help maintain its healthy-looking glow. She also fronts the brand’s “FAST. SLOW. FREE.” Ultimune campaign, which launched earlier this year.

BEST BEAUTY DEAL

Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum

Buy Now on amazon

This lightweight serum combines fermented camellia with 14 amino acids to help skin look smoother, plumper and more radiant.

The serum itself is designed to address multiple signs of aging, including dullness, uneven skin tone, rough texture, fine lines and loss of firmness and elasticity. Its fast-absorbing formula is also made to support the skin barrier and leave the complexion looking smoother, plumper and more radiant.

Shiseido says Ultimune is backed by more than 30 years of research into the skin’s natural defenses. In brand testing, users saw a 54% improvement in the appearance of glow and a 51% improvement in plumpness after three days, while 99% reported that their skin felt smoother.

LISA has even called Ultimune a “go-to product,” noting that she appreciates its focus on strengthening and supporting skin over time.

Luxury skin care rarely comes cheap, which makes Prime Big Deal Days a particularly good time to restock or finally try the serum. The current deal takes $50 off the regular price, dropping Ultimune to $115 through Oct. 7. Like most Prime Day offers , though, the discount won’t stick around for long. Shop the deal while Amazon’s October Prime Day sale is still live.
